summary: Server-authoritative target filtering, deterministic turret-specific priorities, allied and pet protection, multi-target coordination, player warnings and menu-synced controls.

authoritative_state: TurretBaseBlockEntity owns target category flags, multi-target mode, trust policy and warning cooldowns.
TurretHeadBlockEntity validates and scores all candidates and owns its current target and five legacy priority weights.
TurretBaseMenu exposes only server-synchronized ContainerData values to its screen.

fields: owner_team stores the owner's scoreboard team for offline-owner ally protection.
Turret head priority_max_health, priority_missing_health, priority_distance, priority_armor and priority_player fields.
Memory Card schema 2 copies multi-targeting together with existing base configuration.
Warning cooldowns and current targets are transient.

flows.purpose: Apply a bounded targeting configuration intent while the matching base menu is open.
validation: sender has the matching TurretBaseMenu open
rate limit and command value bounds pass

flows.purpose: Synchronize bounded base configuration values to the current menu viewer.
validation: Vanilla menu listeners receive six signed-short-safe values.

client_boundary.dedicated_server_fallback: All targeting, warning and command validation works without client classes.

budgets.measurement: Only the six positions adjacent to the base are inspected.

mods.fallback: The mod refuses to load outside the pinned NeoForge 21.1 line.

Toggle each target class and multi-target mode, then adjust range.

steps: Enable player targeting and approach an active base as an untrusted survival player.
Remain inside the warning area, leave, and re-enter before and after 12000 ticks.
